reason: The hard_v5 V5 lockstep bench (hard outputs at +2 vs production host_v4) fixes the issuer leaf's edges: raw busy/done/fault/uop_v/uop_pc and tap_iteration are flop Q (programme-target feedback at host_v4 edges), uop_d2/busy_d2/done_d2/start_d2 are the leaf's own 2-edge delay flops, tap_steps is the bank face flop AND uop_v (host_v4 mask) captured by the protocol leaf's pin flops; cfg/start/start_pc land in control flops. A synthesis pin stage would add edges the V5 schedule and bench do not carry.
